Third-party assets vendored into this directory.

Nothing here is loaded from a CDN: the site must work from a cold cache with no
third-party request, and a public dataset should not leak its readers to another
host. Only the single-threaded DuckDB build is kept -- the multi-threaded one
needs COOP/COEP response headers that GitHub Pages cannot set, so shipping its
35 MB would be dead weight.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
duckdb/  -- @duckdb/duckdb-wasm 1.33.1-dev57.0, MIT
           https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb-wasm
           duckdb-bundle.mjs is the esbuild output of
           `export * from '@duckdb/duckdb-wasm'`, because the published
           dist/duckdb-browser.mjs has a bare import of "apache-arrow" that a
           plain <script type="module"> cannot resolve. It therefore also
           contains Apache Arrow 21.2.0, Apache-2.0.

uplot/   -- uPlot 1.6.32, MIT, Copyright (c) 2022 Leon Sorokin
           https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot

fonts/   -- IBM Plex Sans, SIL Open Font License 1.1, Copyright (c) 2017 IBM Corp.
           https://github.com/IBM/plex
        -- Spectral, SIL Open Font License 1.1, Copyright (c) 2017 Production Type
           https://github.com/productiontype/Spectral
           Latin subsets only, as served by Google Fonts.
